t.en: In Example “Verifying the inverse of a matrix”, we verified that a matrix $A$ had an inverse. But we did not actually compute the inverse: the inverse $B$ was already given, and we merely checked that $AB=I$ and $BA=I$. We now explore a method for finding the inverse when it is not already known what it is.
t.zh: 在例“验证矩阵的逆”中，我们验证了矩阵 $A$ 有逆。但那时并没有真正去计算这个逆：逆 $B$ 是事先给定的，我们只是验证了 $AB=I$ 和 $BA=I$。现在来探讨：在事先不知道逆是什么的情况下，怎样把它求出来。

title.en: Finding the inverse of a matrix

t.en: Suppose $A$ is an $n\times n$-matrix. To find $A^{-1}$ if it exists, form the augmented $n\times 2n$-matrix
t.zh: 设 $A$ 是 $n\times n$ 矩阵。要求 $A^{-1}$（如果它存在），先构造 $n\times 2n$ 增广矩阵

t.en: If possible, do row operations until you obtain an $n\times 2n$-matrix of the form
t.zh: 如果可能，做行变换，直到得到如下形式的 $n\times 2n$ 矩阵

t.en: If this can be done, then $A$ is invertible and $A^{-1}=B$. If it is not possible (i.e., if the reduced echelon form of $A$ has less than $n$ pivot entries), then $A$ is not invertible.
t.zh: 如果能做到，那么 $A$ 可逆，且 $A^{-1}=B$。如果做不到（即 $A$ 的简化行阶梯形中的主元少于 $n$ 个），那么 $A$ 不可逆。

t.en: This algorithm shows how to find the inverse if it exists. It also tells us if $A$ does not have an inverse.
t.zh: 这个算法说明了：逆存在时怎样求出它；同时它也能告诉我们 $A$ 什么时候没有逆。

title.en: Finding the inverse of a matrix

t.en: Let $A=\left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 & 2 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 3 & 1 & -1 \end{array}\right]$. Find $A^{-1}$ if it exists.
t.zh: 设 $A=\left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 & 2 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 3 & 1 & -1 \end{array}\right]$。如果 $A^{-1}$ 存在，求出它。

t.en: We set up the augmented matrix and reduce it to reduced echelon form.
t.zh: 我们写出增广矩阵，并把它化成简化行阶梯形。

\begin{array}{rcl}\mat{A\mid I} &=&
    \left[\begin{array}{rrr|rrr}

    &\stackrel{R_2\rowop R_2-R_1}{\stackrel{R_3\rowop R_3-3R_1}{\roweq}}&
    \left[\begin{array}{rrr|rrr}

t.en: When looking for the inverse of a matrix, it can happen that the left-hand side cannot be row reduced to the identity matrix. The following is an example of this situation.
t.zh: 在求矩阵的逆时，可能出现左半部分无法通过行变换化成单位矩阵的情形。下面的例子就是这样。

t.en: Let $A=\left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 & -2 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & -2 & 4 \end{array}\right]$. Find $A^{-1}$ if it exists.
t.zh: 设 $A=\left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 & -2 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & -2 & 4 \end{array}\right]$。如果 $A^{-1}$ 存在，求出它。

t.en: We write the augmented matrix
t.zh: 我们写出增广矩阵

t.en: and proceed to do row operations attempting to obtain $\mat{I\mid A^{-1}}$. After a few row operations, we have
t.zh: 并做行变换，试图得到 $\mat{I\mid A^{-1}}$。做几步行变换之后，得到

t.en: At this point, we see that the coefficient matrix has rank $2$, i.e., there are only two pivot entries. This means there is no way to obtain $I$ on the left-hand side of this augmented matrix. Hence, there is no way to complete the algorithm, and the inverse of $A$ does not exist.
t.zh: 此时可以看到，系数矩阵的秩为 $2$，也就是说只有两个主元。这意味着无法在这个增广矩阵的左半部分得到 $I$。因此算法无法完成，$A$ 的逆不存在。

t.en: If the algorithm provides an inverse, it is always possible to double-check that your answer is correct. To do so, use the method demonstrated in Example “Verifying the inverse of a matrix”. Check that the products $AA^{-1}$ and $A^{-1}A$ both equal the identity matrix. Through this method, you can always ensure that you have calculated $A^{-1}$ properly.
t.zh: 如果算法给出了逆，你总是可以再检查一遍答案是否正确。方法就是例“验证矩阵的逆”中演示的那样：验证乘积 $AA^{-1}$ 与 $A^{-1}A$ 都等于单位矩阵。用这个办法，你总能确认自己算出的 $A^{-1}$ 没有错。
